scope: Offline corpus, controlled faults, actual local MCP probes and separately labeled recorded live evidence. Not real-world accuracy.

critic.scope: Ten deliberate verifier faults across three fictional layouts, plus healthy corpus controls. Not a live-model or real-world catch rate.

tools.scope: Predetermined contract/adversarial requests through real MCP, not model tool-selection accuracy. Gold relevance is annotated for the T1 queries; partial keyword matches count against precision.

live.scope: Four recorded Muse Spark cases on fictional labeled statements. Request correctness is schema/result/case grounding, not a proof that the model chose the best action. Check coverage counts model repetition of native verified operand multisets, with order/format normalized and neutral zeros ignored; it is not a bypass of native checks. No model calls are made by this evaluator.
